scope: Selected battle/growth/result labels and state copy in browser review; not a global font minimum or full accessibility certification.
targets: battle: recommendation, health, portrait cooldown, basket age, income, lamp gain, deck cost, bottom navigation
growth: wallet labels, shop stats/milestone, recommendation, placement badge, level, power, cost, hint
growth detail: lineage sharing, stats and effect comparison, resonance explanations
preserved: No changes to cost formulas, limits, balance fixtures, purchase guards, input timing or save/economy model.
contrast: Six browser-computed text/background pairs; gradient stop minimum and translucent background composed over white as a conservative check. Threshold 4.5:1. Whole screen/image-backed labels and ancestor opacity are not certified.
layout: Tall default growth first-row actions visible; two ratios allow scroll in list/detail; fixed controls remain usable.
pending: Unity TMP font atlas/fallback and pixel density
